text:
incident-bot: P1 alert -> model-serving cluster in us-west-2 experiencing a burst of 5xx (predominantly 504) starting 1719987480. Paging on-call (lee) and logging incident page: https://rwinf.incidents/INC-2027

lee: saw the page, traced to overloaded autoscaler + long KV cache compactions. scaled up the pool and routed traffic to cold standby. latency returned to normal at ~1719988102. brief mitigation: bumped pool from 6->12, enabled immediate eviction window. leaving notes in the incident doc.

kelly: thanks lee. can we schedule a PIR this week? need facilitator + runbook review (the autoscaler path failed earlier than expected). prefer someone who can speak to autoscaler heuristics and the runbook changes. cc @product and @support for customer impact notes.

miguel: I can facilitate if needed. offered to co-facilitate with someone from infra for the autoscaler deep-dive. available thurs morning PT or fri afternoon PT.

amanda: friday afternoon PT works for me for attendee coverage (I can pull in CS for impacted customers). can we lock a 60m slot? also want to include a short post-incident customer-impact section (10m).

lee: friday 2024-06-21 16:00 PT (23:00 UTC) or thurs 2024-06-20 09:30 PT (16:30 UTC) — which is better for EMEA folks?

kelly: preference for thurs 09:30 PT to catch infra before EOW, but I know EMEA might be tough. can we do a quick availability sweep? please react with :thumbsup: for thurs OR :thumbsdown: for friday.

miguel: agenda draft below — feel free to edit.
```
1) 5m - quick timeline + impact (lee)
2) 15m - mitigation and runbook step review (lee + infra rep)
3) 20m - root cause analysis + technical decisions (miguel)
4) 10m - customer impact & comms (amanda)
5) 10m - action items, owners, and SLAs for fixes (kelly)
```

amanda: +1 on that agenda. action item to add a dedicated owner for runbook PR and for autoscaler tuning config. I raised a placeholder PR: https://github.com/rwinf/runbooks/pull/402 (runbook tweak) — needs review before PIR so we can discuss concrete changes.

lee: assigning owners in-thread:
- runbook PR review -> miguel
- autoscaler config changes (thresholds + cool-down) -> lee
- customer comms draft -> amanda

kelly: that's helpful. can we also add a pre-read? a short 1-pager with metrics (qps, 99p latency, error-rate) and the runbook diff. If owners can post pre-reads by thurs 07:00 PT that'd be ideal.

miguel: I will post the runbook diff and a short notes doc by thurs 06:45 PT. link will be in the PIR invite.

oncall-ops-bot: Calendar event created by miguel: "PIR - model-serving 504 spike (facilitator: miguel)" scheduled 2024-06-20T09:30:00-07:00. Invite: https://calendar.rwinf/ev/83729.

lee: added incident postmortem section in the doc with mitigation commands and logs. will attach KV cache stats and autoscaler logs.

kelly: perfect. i'll ping legal and security for the compliance note just in case (low risk but procedure). anyone else to add to attendee list? please add :person_with_laptop: infra leads, product owners, and one CS rep.

amanda: I'll add CS and product. tagging @support-lead to eyeball comms.

miguel: thanks all — i'll take facilitator prep and make sure pre-reads are in. see you thurs. :raised_hands:
